description: Defines template classes for lock-based multi-producer multi-consumer concurrent queues with non-blocking and blocking mechanisms, including specializations using condition variables.

classes.name: concurrent_queue<T, concurrent_queue_policy::locking_mpmc, concurrent_queue_wait_policy::non_blocking>
classes.description: A lock-based MPMC queue with non-blocking push and pop operations.

classes.name: concurrent_queue<T, concurrent_queue_policy::locking_mpmc, concurrent_queue_wait_policy::condition_variable>
classes.description: A lock-based MPMC queue using condition variables for blocking operations, inheriting from the non-blocking version.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to push an element into the queue without blocking.

methods.name: try_push_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to push a bulk of elements into the queue non-blockingly.

methods.name: push_blocking
methods.description: Pushes an element into the queue, blocking if necessary until space is available.

methods.name: try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to pop an element from the queue without blocking.

methods.name: try_pop_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to pop multiple elements from the queue non-blockingly.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the queue.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of the queue.

methods.name: create_consumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer object for the queue.

methods.name: pop_blocking
methods.description: Blocks until an element is available and pops it.

methods.name: pop_blocking with timeout
methods.description: Blocks for a specified duration until an element is available and pops it.
